about: Setavaz's code-made models, sets, textures and effects as the Ahura library knows them (ahura-hub docs/library.md, the same shape as Pickwise's packages/motion/src/v2/set/library.json). One row per thing: its id in the library, the file and the function that makes it, its names, what it shows, how it was made and under which licence. Every file stands alone: it needs three.js and the small helpers in util/ only. A new make* function needs its row here (r3/gate.test.mjs holds the two together). Before writing a new object, ask the library whether another project already has it. No sound is made here: a Short's only sound is the track itself.
asked: Asked on 16 Nov 2026 before making these (ahura-hub lib/library/entries): no fire bowl, charcoal, weathervane, turret roof, crucible, mould, flame, lightning, storm cloud or rain entry existed in any project, so all are new. Asked again on 20 Nov 2026 (POST /api/library/find, kind model) before the Yalda, Night Drive and Focus worlds: no pomegranate, candle, candlestick, tea glass, saucer, book, desk lamp, notebook, pencil, hourglass, desk, car gauge, steering wheel, nazar bead, rear-view mirror or steam existed in any project (Pickwise has a cup and a counter, not these), so all are new.

names.en: Cast-iron fire bowl with ring handles

entries.depicts: A wide, shallow iron bowl on a round foot, one metre across, with a rolled rim and two hanging ring handles

made.detail: makeFireBowl(): one lathed section for foot, waist, bowl and rim; torus handles; grain as bump and roughness

entries.depicts: One broken lump of charcoal whose glowing veins can be turned from black to burning

made.detail: makeCoal(seed, size): an icosphere pushed by noise into a split lump; its heat is an emissive map; userData.heat(k)

entries.depicts: The grey ash that lies in the fire bowl under the coals

made.detail: makeAshBed(): a lathed low dome, roughened by noise

names.en: Hearth: fire bowl with ash and a pile of coals

entries.depicts: The fire bowl as it stands in «Last Ember»: ash, thirty lumps of charcoal and one hero ember on top

made.detail: makeHearth(): the bowl, the ash bed and makeCoalPile() together

names.en: Copper weathervane with an arrow and a four-point star
names.fa: بادنمای مسی با پیکان و ستارهٔ چهارپر

entries.depicts: A copper weathervane about 2.1 m tall: mast, two globes, four cardinal arms, a turning arrow with a swallow-tail, the label's star and a spike

made.detail: makeWeathervane(): cylinders, spheres and bevelled extruded plates in one copper material; the head turns about the mast

entries.depicts: The top of a twelve-sided bell-curved turret roof clad in copper gone green, with rolled seams on its ridges

made.detail: makeTurretRoof(): a twelve-sided lathe with flat faces, tube seams along the ridges, the verdigris texture

entries.depicts: A graphite crucible with a pouring lip, hot at the rim and inside, full of molten metal

made.detail: makeCruciblePot(): a lathed thick-walled pot with the lip pinched into the rim; the wall's heat is an emissive map

entries.depicts: The crucible held by a steel band on two trunnions between two uprights, with a lever to tip it

made.detail: makeCrucible(): the pot, a torus band, pins, box uprights and a lever; setTilt(angle), lipWorld()

names.en: Round sand mould with a ring channel
names.fa: قالب ماسه‌ای گرد با شیار حلقه

entries.depicts: A round steel foundry flask packed with dark sand; a ring-shaped channel and a pouring basin are pressed into it

made.detail: makeRingMould(): a lathed steel band and a lathed sand bed with a half-round groove; the basin is pressed in by moving points

entries.depicts: The metal in the mould's channel: it fills both ways round from the basin, glows, and cools from white-yellow to dark red

made.detail: makeMoltenRing(): two strips of a lens-shaped section drawn up to the fill; metalColour(heat) is its colour

entries.depicts: A flame that licks upward: a teardrop eaten by rising noise, white at the core, orange, red at the edge

made.detail: makeFlame(): a camera-facing plane with a small GLSL shader; set(time, power, gain)

entries.depicts: Sparks that fly up or out, slow in the air, cool from white-yellow to red and die

made.detail: makeSparks(bursts): glowing points on closed-form paths, so any frame can be drawn alone

entries.depicts: A jagged lightning channel with thinner branches, from a point in the cloud to where it lands

made.detail: makeBolt({ from, to, seed }): midpoint displacement drawn as fat lines; strikeEnvelope() is its flicker

entries.depicts: Dark storm clouds all round and overhead, which light up from inside when lightning flashes

made.detail: makeCloudDeck(): about two hundred soft puffs (sprites); light(flashes) colours each by its distance to the flashes

entries.depicts: Rain in a box of air: streaks while it falls, hanging drops when it is held still

made.detail: makeRain(): line segments and points wrapped in a box; update(fall, speed, light)

entries.depicts: A sky painted from the ground colour through the horizon to the zenith, and far stars of three sizes

made.detail: makeSkyDome() paints a sphere's points; makeStars() scatters glowing points on the upper dome

names.en: Ground disc with grain and a contact shadow
names.fa: زمین با بافت ریز و سایهٔ تماس

entries.depicts: A wide stone or concrete ground that takes shadows, and a soft dark patch that seats an object on it

made.detail: makeGround() and makeContactShadow(): a disc with a grain texture; a radial alpha patch

entries.depicts: Dark crust with glowing veins and hot patches, for an emissive map

made.detail: emberTexture(seed): tiling fractal noise, ridged for the veins, 256 px, drawn by code

entries.depicts: Green weathered copper with brown-copper streaks running down

made.detail: verdigrisTexture(seed): stretched noise streaks over blotches, 256 px, drawn by code

entries.depicts: Smooth and dull blotches for copper that has lived outdoors (a roughness map)

made.detail: copperRoughTexture(seed): tiling noise in the green channel, 256 px

entries.depicts: Fine grey grain for cast iron, sand, stone and concrete (bump and roughness)

made.detail: grainTexture(seed): two octaves of tiling noise, 256 px

entries.depicts: A soft blob whose edge is eaten by noise, for clouds and smoke

made.detail: puffTexture(seed): a radial falloff minus noise, 128 px

entries.depicts: A round glow like a light out of focus: sparks, drops, far lights

made.detail: glowTexture(): a radial falloff, 64 px

entries.depicts: How hot a crucible's wall is from the foot to the rim and down inside (an emissive map)

made.detail: crucibleHeatTexture(): a gradient along the lathe's section, 64 px

entries.depicts: A whole pomegranate about 9 cm across: glossy deep-red skin with five soft ribs and the six-pointed crown

made.detail: makePomegranate(): one lathed outline with ribs and noise pushed into it; the crown is a flared lathe tube with six cones

entries.depicts: Half a pomegranate cut across: the red rind, cream pith with the pale membranes, and about seventy glossy ruby seeds

made.detail: makePomegranateHalf(): the half outline lathed, a pith face drawn by code (pithTexture), the seeds as one InstancedMesh

entries.depicts: A pomegranate as two halves: open(0) is the whole fruit, open(1) the top half turned over onto the table, seeds up

made.detail: makeOpeningPomegranate(): two makePomegranateHalf; the resting place of the top half is measured so it never sinks into the table

entries.depicts: A short brass candlestick: a wide foot, a turned stem with rings, a drip tray and a cup

made.detail: makeCandlestick(): one lathed section, brass with fine grain

names.en: Lit ivory candle in a brass candlestick

entries.depicts: A tall ivory candle with a melted lip and two drips, a black wick and a living flame, in the brass candlestick

made.detail: makeLitCandle(): a lathed wax body that glows a little with the flame, capsule drips, effects/flame.mjs sheets for the flame

names.en: Estekan of tea on a saucer

entries.depicts: The small waisted Persian tea glass full of dark amber tea, on a white porcelain saucer with a gold rim; the tea surface can ripple

made.detail: makeTeaGlass(): lathed glass (outline and inside), lathed tea, a polar-grid surface the scene ripples; a lathed saucer and a gold torus rim

entries.depicts: An open divan: dark red leather boards with gold tooling, two curved page blocks with verses in two columns drawn as ink strokes (no letters), and a loose page that turns

made.detail: makeOpenBook(): boxes for boards and blocks, bent planes for the pages (versePageTexture), one page that turns about the spine

entries.depicts: A desk lamp in dark green enamel and brass: round base, two arms with ball joints, a conical shade with a glowing bulb

made.detail: makeDeskLamp(): lathed base and shade, cylinder arms, sphere joints; pose(b1, b2, tilt) bends it

entries.depicts: A spiral notebook open flat on ruled cream pages; the right page fills with dark blue handwriting line by line (ink strokes, never letters)

made.detail: makeNotebook(): boxes and planes, ruledPageTexture, a shader that draws the ink up to write(k); penAt(k) says where the pen is

entries.depicts: A hexagonal ochre pencil with a sharpened wooden tip, graphite point, metal ferrule and pink eraser

made.detail: makePencil(): hexagonal cylinder, cones and small cylinders

entries.depicts: An hourglass: two glass bulbs between walnut discs held by three turned brass posts; the sand runs with sand(k)

made.detail: makeHourglass(): lathed glass, discs and posts; the sand as two cones and a thread scaled by sand(k)

entries.depicts: Two round car gauges with chrome bezels, backlit amber faces with ticks (no numbers) and orange needles, in a black binnacle under a curved hood

made.detail: makeCluster(): makeGauge() twice (lathed bezel, dialTexture face, box needle) in a box and an extruded hood

entries.depicts: A leather three-spoke steering wheel with the gold Setavaz star on its hub

made.detail: makeSteeringWheel(): a torus rim, a cylinder hub, three boxes and the star shape

entries.depicts: A cobalt-blue glass bead with the white, pale blue and dark blue eye on its front

made.detail: makeNazar(): a sphere and three sphere caps of glossy glass

names.en: Rear-view mirror with a hanging charm

entries.depicts: A car rear-view mirror on its stem with a charm hanging below on a red cord: a nazar bead and a gold four-point star that swing

made.detail: makeMirrorCharm(): an extruded rounded mirror with a metal glass, a cord, makeNazar and the extruded star; swing(x, z)
